parameters.query:
SELECT t.id, t.titulo, t.prazo, t.cobranca_count, t.criada_em, t.dono_numero, d.timezone,
  CASE
    WHEN t.prazo IS NOT NULL AND t.prazo < (NOW() AT TIME ZONE d.timezone)::date THEN 'atrasada'
    WHEN t.prazo IS NOT NULL AND t.prazo = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE d.timezone)::date THEN 'hoje'
    ELSE 'normal'
  END AS urgencia
FROM giulia_tarefas t
JOIN giulia_donos d ON d.numero = t.dono_numero
WHERE t.status = 'pendente'
  AND COALESCE(d.status, 'ativo') = 'ativo'
  AND (t.proxima_cobranca_em IS NULL OR t.proxima_cobranca_em <= NOW())
  AND (COALESCE(d.cobranca_modo, 'padrao') != 'diaria' OR to_char(NOW() AT TIME ZONE d.timezone, 'HH24')::int BETWEEN 7 AND 10)
  AND (d.numero = '5511910441709' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM giulia_memoria m WHERE m.from_numero = d.numero AND m.role = 'user' AND m.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 days'))
ORDER BY t.dono_numero, (t.prazo IS NULL), t.prazo ASC, t.criada_em ASC
LIMIT 10;
